truthReference: Independent hand audit of validation/m12/fixtures/rust/*.rs against Rust semantics and the M11 Rust contract (validated 1.000/1.000 in M11.10; symbols only). Symbols: modules -> module; traits -> trait (methods -> method); structs (incl. unit structs) -> struct with fields -> property; impl blocks -> impl (named after the implemented type — M11 contract); methods -> method; constructors keep their fn name (new); enums -> enum with variants -> enum_member; free functions -> function; pub use re-exports stay in imports (no dangling references edge). Noise (negative contract): function-local let bindings, closure parameters, primitive types, generic parameters, lifetimes, tuple indices. Rust fields default to private; only pub fields are public. Relationships (family contract, matches Java M12.01 / C M12.16 / C++ M12.17): contains = REAL container ownership only (trait->method, struct->property, impl->method, enum->variant) — never `global contains X` or `root contains X`; calls = method/function -> callee leaf name (member calls self.repository.add -> add, chains values.iter().map()... each emit one calls edge, macros println! -> println — one edge per pair, never calls+uses for the same pair); uses = non-call field access only (self.counter, u.id — field_identifier only, tuple indices like tuple.0 are not symbols and emit nothing; call-target field expressions skip the uses walk); instantiates = struct literals (User { ... } -> User) and Rust constructor calls (::new() -> new, paired with calls — documented); implements = trait impl (MemoryStorage -> Repository, leaf trait name; generic/qualified trait paths super::Repository<User> resolve to the leaf Repository); extends = trait bounds (trait Foo: Bar). Imports (use declarations) are captured in the imports array only — no references edge (Java-family contract, unlike C's include dependencies which target header files). Cross-file declarations (User in service.rs, used in storage.rs) do not resolve in a per-file parse — production companion-index wiring tracked by M12.44 (same note as Java/C/C++).
note: M12 per-analyzer differential for rust. Precision/recall/fp/fn/unknown computed against independent ground truth. Identity contract: symbol facts keyed by file:line:kind:name; relationship facts keyed by file:type:sourceId:targetId with attributes={type} only (no line, no extra fields) so the comparison measures extraction correctness, not naming noise.
